lessons.text: In the AP mailbox at /mail, select the latest vendor email that has an invoice attachment, skip reminder/follow-up emails without attachments, click the attachment to download, then read the PDF text layer.

Check duplicate bills via GET /bills?vendor_id={vendor_id}&invoice_number={invoice_number}; if none, record a new bill at /erp/bills/new by filling vendor, invoice number, dates, amount, and description.
On the bill page, set Payment date to the invoice due date and click Schedule payment; invoices of INR 50,000 or more route automatically for Finance Manager approval before scheduling.
The ERP vendor master stores email_domain and bank account on file; the sender's domain must exactly match email_domain before processing an invoice.
Do not process reminder/follow-up emails from a vendor without an invoice attachment; they can be mistaken for the latest invoice email and waste steps.
